findings.title: Sparse array holes pass validation, contradicting the design
findings.why: `Array.prototype.every` skips holes, so a value such as `[ , 1]` or `new Array(3)` is accepted as valid. design.md says holes read as `undefined` and are rejected, and the spec requires `undefined` at any depth to be rejected. The holes then reach `cloneJson` and the document. No test covers it.

findings.title: Circular values overflow the stack instead of raising JsonPatchError
findings.why: `isJsonValue` recurses with no cycle guard. A `value` that contains itself, for example `const o = {}; o.self = o`, throws a raw `RangeError` (stack overflow). The spec says any violation SHALL cause an error, and the project reports problems as `JsonPatchError`. A very deeply nested value fails the same way.
